candidates.label: Clear conquest granted with forgiveness, favour completion and guidance
candidates.definition: In 48:1-2: Indeed We have given you a clear conquest that Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favour upon you and guide you to a straight path.

evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Tranquillity increasing faith alongside existing faith
candidates.definition: In 48:4: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their present faith; and to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Evil assumption about Allah earning anger, curse and Hell
candidates.definition: In 48:6: And that He may punish the hypocrite men and women and polytheist men and women who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature; upon them is misfortune of evil nature and Allah has become angry with them and cursed them and prepared Hell.

evidence.excerpt: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَنَهُمۡ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Pledge to the Prophet identified as pledge to Allah with His hand over theirs
candidates.definition: In 48:10: Indeed those who pledge allegiance to you are actually pledging allegiance to Allah; the hand of Allah is over their hands; so he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself, and he who fulfills what he promised Allah, He will give him a great reward.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Bedouin excuses masking inner disbelief exposed by divine acquaintance
candidates.definition: In 48:11-12: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say our properties and families occupied us so ask forgiveness for us; they say with their tongues what is not within their hearts; but you thought the Messenger and believers would never return and assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined.

evidence.excerpt: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡنَآ أَمۡوَٰلُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَاۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلۡسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيۡسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ فَمَن يَمۡلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ ضَرًّا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ نَفۡعَۢاۚ بَلۡ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرَۢا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: بَلۡ ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِيهِمۡ أَبَدٗا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Battle exemptions for the blind, lame and ill with obedience-reward framework
candidates.definition: In 48:17: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt for remaining behind; and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow.

evidence.excerpt: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Allah's pleasure with the pledge under the tree confirmed by heart-knowledge
candidates.definition: In 48:18: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree and He knew what was in their hearts so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest.

evidence.excerpt: ۞لَّقَدۡ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَٰبَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Unchanging established way of Allah across history
candidates.definition: In 48:23: This is the established way of Allah which has occurred before; and never will you find in the way of Allah any change.

evidence.excerpt: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Restraint at Makkah protecting unknown believers from trampling-dishonour
candidates.definition: In 48:25: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice; and if not for believing men and women whom you did not know that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without knowledge, you would have been permitted to enter.

evidence.excerpt: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالٞ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٞ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٞ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Jahiliyya chauvinism against tranquillity and the word of righteousness
candidates.definition: In 48:26: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism, the chauvinism of the time of ignorance; but Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it.

evidence.excerpt: إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Vision of safe Masjid entry confirmed with near conquest arranged
candidates.definition: In 48:27: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth; you will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram if Allah wills in safety with your heads shaved and hair shortened not fearing anyone; He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near at hand.

evidence.excerpt: لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Religion of truth sent to prevail over all religions with Allah as Witness
candidates.definition: In 48:28: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion; and sufficient is Allah as Witness.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Companions described in Torah and Gospel as strengthening plant delighting sowers
candidates.definition: In 48:29: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers merciful among themselves; you see them bowing and prostrating seeking bounty from Allah and His pleasure; their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration; that is their description in the Torah and their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks delighting the sowers so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers; Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

evidence.excerpt: مُّحَمَّدٞ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعٗا سُجَّدٗا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
